categories.main_business_segments: Thye Ming Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the manufacturing and trading of lead and lead alloy products, including lead ingots, lead alloys, and lead oxides (yellow and red lead). The company also operates in waste lead-acid battery recycling and processing, chemical product trading, and general and industrial waste disposal. Its products mainly serve the lead-acid battery industry, accounting for about 92% of revenue, with additional sales in pigments and other lead-related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes electrochemical refining and smelting processes for metals such as copper, aluminum, tin, zinc, and antimony. Lead alloy production involves refining lead ingots and recycled lead from waste lead-acid batteries through crushing, smelting, and refining furnaces. The production of lead oxides (yellow and red lead) follows a process of melting lead ingots, powdering, and roasting. The company emphasizes automation, cost reduction, and environmental compliance in its manufacturing methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Thye Ming's primary customers are lead-acid battery manufacturers serving automotive, motorcycle, UPS (uninterruptible power supply), and industrial energy storage sectors. The company also supplies to industries such as paint, pigment, glass, ceramics, shipbuilding, and radiation shielding. Its domestic market accounts for approximately 44% of sales, while exports (56%) focus on Southeast Asia countries including Vietnam, Malaysia, Japan, Indonesia, and Thailand.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with significant export markets in Southeast Asia, including Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and Japan. It has overseas subsidiaries in Vietnam and Samoa to support production and investment activities. The company’s supply chain and sales network extend across Asia, with a focus on the Asia-Pacific region as a key growth market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Thye Ming operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lead supply chain, focusing on processing and refining lead ingots and recycled lead into lead alloys and oxides. It also engages in upstream activities through recycling and smelting waste lead-acid batteries, and downstream by supplying processed lead products to battery manufacturers and other industrial users, thus maintaining vertical integration within the lead industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include vertical integration, cost reduction, environmental sustainability, and product innovation. R&D efforts focus on developing new lead alloys with improved performance for lead-acid batteries, such as low self-discharge lead-calcium alloys and enhanced lead-tin alloys with better conductivity and corrosion resistance. It also invests in improving recycling technologies and green smelting processes to align with ESG goals and regulatory compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of lead ingots, lead alloys, and lead oxide products to battery manufacturers and industrial customers. Additional income comes from waste lead-acid battery recycling and processing services, as well as trading of chemical products and industrial waste disposal. The company operates on a product sales model with long-term contracts and diversified customer base domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Thye Ming is positioned as the leading listed company in Taiwan’s lead products industry, with a strong market share of approximately 85% in domestic lead alloy sales and 60% in yellow and red lead products. It differentiates itself through comprehensive product lines, high-quality standards certified by ISO9001, ISO14001, and ISO/TS16949, and exclusive licenses for waste lead-acid battery processing. Competitors include smaller legal and illegal recyclers, but Thye Ming’s scale, product quality, and timely delivery provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$8.55 billion, a 7.18% decrease from the prior year, with a net profit attributable to owners of about NT$1.05 billion, representing a 5.88% increase. Total assets stood at around NT$7.36 billion with equity of NT$6.57 billion. The company maintains stable profitability with return on assets around 14% and return on equity over 16%, reflecting steady growth and strong financial health despite market fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Thye Ming emphasizes superior product quality, environmental responsibility, and comprehensive service as its core value propositions. It is the first in Taiwan to obtain licenses for waste lead-acid battery recycling, enabling cost-effective raw material sourcing and environmental compliance. The company’s extensive product line, advanced manufacturing technology, and certifications ensure reliable supply and high-quality standards, meeting stringent customer requirements in automotive and industrial battery sectors. Its commitment to ESG and sustainable practices further differentiates it in the market.
